critical_code_review_comments: _try_acquire_lock does not release the lock in _books_autopilot_loop by design (comment says 'let TTL expire naturally' so eager loops don't chain). That works, but if BOOKS_AUTOPILOT_INTERVAL_SECONDS ever gets shorter than the TTL used, the loop will silently skip runs. Consider computing lock TTL as `max(30, interval - 30)` (already done) but document the invariant, or add a metric so admins notice skipped runs.

The Access-Denied → Dutch hint mapping matches on the lowercased substring 'access denied' OR 'access_denied'. Live creds work now so this path is untested end-to-end from Zoho; recommend adding an offline unit test that feeds a mock ZohoAuthError('ACCESS_DENIED') into _books_autopilot_scan_once and asserts the Dutch string is present in errors[0].

books_autopilot_status collection stores one doc keyed _id='last_run' — good, but there's no history. If a run fails, the next successful run overwrites the error and the CMS chip flips green with no trail. Consider keeping the last 20 runs in a separate collection (or appending to a history array) for audit.

BulkTranslateButton countdown uses a 1s setTimeout loop inside a for-loop — if the admin closes the modal mid-wait the loop keeps ticking on the state. cancelRef.current halts the outer while but the inner `await sleep(1000)` still resolves once. Not a real bug (setProgress is guarded by cancelRef), but ensure that closing/unmounting sets cancelRef so we don't setState after unmount (React warning).

ProjectsAdmin previewEn toggles title_en/description_en only in the list; the edit form still edits NL fields. That's the intended read-only preview, but there's no path to edit the EN copy from this page other than the per-row AI translate button. Consider a small '✎ EN' button on rows when previewEn is on.
